packageRules.description: Skip HMCTS feature-branch builds published with a ticket suffix (e.g. 4.1.0-CCD-8220, 9.2.12_CCD-8388). Maven versioning ranks unknown qualifiers above the release, so Renovate otherwise treats them as the newest stable version. Kept first so the package-specific allowedVersions rules below still override it
Version 5.4.0 already needs Spring Boot 4 (it requires org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-http-converter), as does version 6 with Jackson 3; retain the compatible client until the service migrates

Spring Cloud 2025.1 targets Spring Boot 4: its OpenFeign loads org.springframework.boot.http.converter.autoconfigure.ClientHttpMessageConvertersCustomizer, which Boot 3.5 lacks, so the application context fails to start
Version 6 is built for Java 25; the service still compiles for Java 21
Version 3.2 requires Spring Boot 4; retain the compatible client until the service migrates
Version 1.60.0 requires Spring Boot 4; retain the compatible client until the service migrates
Byte Buddy 1.18.16 and 1.18.17 stop Mockito mocking CaseData on Java 25 ('Could not modify all classes'), aborting EventHistoryMapperTest; later versions are still offered so CI can confirm a fix
Hold actions/setup-python below 3.15: semgrep 1.177.0 needs ruamel.yaml.clib 0.2.15, which has no 3.15 build (pii-log-check), and the email-docs generator tests fail on 3.15
These BOMs only set CVE minimums (DTSCCI-6473): take patch releases on the Reactor and Micrometer lines Spring Boot manages, and move to a new line together with Spring Boot

Restrict HMCTS library upgrades to minor/patch versions. Major versions may introduce incompatibilities with Spring Boot or other core dependencies (e.g., ccd-case-document-am-client v1.60.0 requires Spring Boot 4.0.6, incompatible with project's Spring Boot 3.3.7)
Keep the Terraform CLI version (infrastructure/.terraform-version) out of the npm non-major group; large jumps can affect state and providers, so review and merge manually
Keep the cnp-jenkins-library @Library bump in Jenkinsfiles out of the npm non-major group so pipeline changes are tested on their own
Camunda upgrades are isolated in their own group and require manual review to prevent build failures
DTSCCI-7065: Hold CCD chart updates until the chart size regression is resolved and the packaged civil-service chart is safely below the size limit
Require manual review of AAC chart updates because the chart also bundles CCD
No Spring major updates until the Spring Boot 4 migration (the spring-boot-4 branch) lands: the major group needs Boot 4 and cannot compile on master, so its PR fails on every rebase
